annotations.text:
Four treatments of the strip, then four arrows, then four marker housings, then the rules any replacement has to satisfy.

Everything is drawn at the shipped sizes over a scene, because a compass that reads on a dark panel and vanishes over Tanaris is not a compass.

The arrow art here is the REAL arrow-gw2.tga and arrow.tga, decoded out of the addon, not redrawn from memory.

Measuring it turned up a real defect: the ink sits 8px above the texture centre, so the arrow orbits its own axis as it rotates.

Read this board before picking. Two of the concepts cost NO new art (they remove drawing), one costs a redraw, and one costs a second texture.

The 8-corner rotation also means a single centred arrow could serve standalone too, deleting the 108-cell sprite sheet.
